messages:
Elena (Sales): Hey finance/deal-desk — Sapphire Hospitality wants to modify their Dedicated commit. Request: reduce min monthly GPU commit from 80 -> 50 for the first 6 months, add a one-time onboarding credit of $25k, and a retro credit for last month's spike of $9,400. Need deal-desk + legal signoff. Can we fast-track? /cc @Miguel @Aisha

Aisha (Finance Ops): Can you drop ARR/commit numbers + the business reason? I need to run the elasticity and cashflow impact. Also confirm whether this affects SLA or billing terms.

Elena (Sales): Tier = mid-market enterprise, current committed spend ~$120k/mo (80 GPUs). Reason: property rollout delayed by vendor; they won't consume full commit the first 6 months but expect to scale to 80 by month 9. They prefer a short-term commit reduction instead of buying burst credits monthly.

Miguel (Deal Desk): Quick thoughts — onboarding credit $25k is probably OK if restricted to professional services/integration. Retro cash credit $9.4k is over my auto-approve threshold. Alternative: offer capped burst credits for months 1-3 (e.g., $10k cap) instead of a retro cash refund.

Connor (AE): Customer will push back on anything other than cash credit — procurement said cash credit is easier for their finance team. If we avoid retro cash they might escalate to their CRO. Want to keep relationship smooth.

Aisha (Finance Ops): Please paste the month-by-month usage forecast and confirm no SLA changes. Also need to know whether tax treatment changes for a retro credit.

Elena (Sales): Forecast for the next 6 months (GPU-equivalent usage): 50, 55, 60, 70, 75, 80. They ramp to full commit by month 9. No SLA change requested. They asked specifically for the one-time $25k onboarding + $9.4k retro for last-month overage.

Miguel (Deal Desk): Rough calc for context:
```
Scenario A: reduce billed commit to 50 GPUs for 6 months (customer pays less) -> revenue impact large up-front.
Scenario B: keep billed commit but issue credit/true-up -> gives accounting clarity for both sides.
Recommend: keep commit in contract, issue one-time onboarding credit $25k, and consider capped burst credits instead of retro cash to avoid precedent.
```

Liam (Legal): We need an amendment: 1) explicit expiry for the onboarding credit, 2) a clause clarifying that retro credit does not waive remedies for contract breaches, and 3) add an early-termination adjustment if commit changes. I can draft a short addendum if Finance ok with amounts.

Aisha (Finance Ops): Running policy check now. If retro credit is $9.4k that exceeds my $5k approval limit — will need VP Finance signoff. Also want the deal desk form filled with forecast + fiscal GL mapping.

deal-desk-bot: Policy check: RETRO_CREDIT_AMOUNT=9400 -> exceeds approver_limit=5000. FLAGGED -> requires VP Finance (Marta) approval. Discount_pct_est=21% -> exceeds 20% auto-threshold.

Elena (Sales): Oof. QBR with customer is Friday. Can we escalate to Marta for an exception? This is time sensitive.

Miguel (Deal Desk): I can pre-approve the onboarding credit $25k conditionally (restricted to PS hours). Retro $9.4k needs Marta. I'll prepare the deal desk form with two options: (A) $25k onboarding + $9.4k retro cash (escalate), (B) $25k onboarding + $10k capped burst credits (deal-desk approved).

Aisha (Finance Ops): I'll route to Marta with the forecast, legal caveats, and GL mapping. Internal tracking code: FIN-DEV-2981. Please attach the SOW excerpt and usage telemetry.

Connor (AE): I'll ask the customer if they can accept interim capped burst credits while we get Marta's signoff. Keeps them happy and buys time.

Miguel (Deal Desk): @Liam can you prepare a redline addendum for option A and B? If Marta signs off we can get signatures by Thursday.

Liam (Legal): On it. I'll include the expiry language and an explicit statement that the onboarding credit is non-transferable and contingent on MSA addendum.

Aisha (Finance Ops): Submitted for VP review at 2312347860 — pinged Marta with the form + attachments. Will update thread once she responds.

Elena (Sales): Thanks everyone — will hold off on final comms to the customer until we hear back.

Miguel (Deal Desk): TL;DR: Pre-approve onboarding $25k (conditional); retro $9.4k requires Marta signoff or we offer capped burst credits as fallback. I'll upload the formal deal desk packet in the form tool shortly.
